version.source: import { host } from "host"; const status = await host.server.status(); const { x, y, z } = status.demoLocation; await Promise.all([host.world.spawnEntity({ type: "ZOMBIE", x: x + 1, y, z }), host.world.spawnEntity({ type: "ZOMBIE", x: x - 1, y, z }), host.world.spawnEntity({ type: "ZOMBIE", x, y, z: z + 1 })]);
